Bakit kulay-abo ang kalabaw?

Ang kulay-abo ng kalabaw ay galing sa natural na kulay na tinatawag na melanin sa balat nito. Mas maraming melanin, mas madilim ang kulay.
copy.bis:
Ngano abuhon ang kalabaw?

Ang abuhon nga kolor sa kalabaw naggikan sa natural nga kolor nga gitawag melanin sa iyang panit. Kon mas daghan ang melanin, mas itom ang kolor.

copy.en: A carabao's thick, tough hide can be turned into strong leather for shoes, belts, and more.
copy.tl: Ang makapal na balat ng kalabaw ay magagawang matibay na katad para sa sapatos, sinturon, at iba pa.
copy.bis: Ang baga nga panit sa kalabaw mahimong himoong lig-on nga katad para sa sapatos, bakos, ug uban pa.

The card does not frame this as an evolutionary change or use secondary sources, so it only relates to the broad topic of adaptation.

copy.en:
Why does a carabao roll in mud?

A carabao doesn't sweat much, so it wallows in mud to cool its body down during hot weather.
copy.tl:
Bakit lumululbog sa putik ang kalabaw?

Hindi gaanong pinagpapawisan ang kalabaw, kaya lumulubog ito sa putik para palamigin ang katawan tuwing tag-init.
copy.bis:
Nganong molublob sa lapok ang kalabaw?

Dili kaayo mosingot ang kalabaw, mao nga molublob kini sa lapok aron mobugnaw ang lawas panahon sa init.

copy.en:
Why is carabao milk white?

Tiny droplets of fat and protein float inside it and scatter light, making the milk look white.
copy.tl:
Bakit puti ang gatas ng kalabaw?

Maraming maliliit na butil ng taba at protina ang lumulutang dito at kumakalat ng liwanag, kaya puti ang nakikita natin.
copy.bis:
Nganong puti ang gatas sa kabaw?

Daghang gagmayng tinulo sa tambok ug protina ang naglutaw niini ug nagsabwag sa kahayag, mao nga puti ang atong makita.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that there is a need to protect and conserve the environment for living things to survive
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about caring for and protecting the carabao as the national animal, focusing on animal welfare. The card does not address environmental protection or conservation; it only mentions humane treatment of one animal, which is not the same as conserving the environment.

copy.en: Because the carabao is our national animal, we should take care of it, feed it well, and never treat it cruelly.
copy.tl: Dahil pambansang hayop natin ang kalabaw, dapat natin itong alagaan, pakainin nang maayos, at huwag pagmalupitan.
copy.bis: Tungod kay nasodnong hayop nato ang kabaw, kinahanglan natong atimanon kini, pakan-on og maayo, ug dili daugdaugon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: dedicated to studying how to keep carabaos healthier and more helpful to farmers
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe examples and explain how living things depend on one another and on the environment to meet their basic needs
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions carabaos and farmers but does not teach how living things depend on one another or on the environment to meet basic needs. It only states that an agency studies carabao health and usefulness, which is tangential to the competency.

copy.en: There's a whole government agency, the Philippine Carabao Center, dedicated to studying how to keep carabaos healthier and more helpful to farmers.
copy.tl: May ahensya ng gobyerno, ang Philippine Carabao Center, na nag-aaral kung paano gawing mas malusog at mas kapaki-pakinabang ang mga kalabaw sa mga magsasaka.
copy.bis: Adunay ahensya sa gobyerno, ang Philippine Carabao Center, nga nagatuon kung unsaon paghimong mas himsog ug mas mapuslanon ang mga kabaw sa mga mag-uuma.

copy.en: The carabao is strong with powerful muscles, so it can handle heavy work on the farm!
copy.tl: Malakas ang kalabaw at may matibay na kalamnan, kaya kaya nitong gumawa ng mabibigat na trabaho sa bukid!
copy.bis: Kusgan ang kalabaw ug adunay lig-on nga kaunoran, mao nga kaya niini ang bug-at nga trabaho sa umahan!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Regular bathing keeps a carabao's skin clean and healthy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions skin, an outer body part, but does not describe its role in movement or gathering food as required by the competency. It only discusses cleanliness, so it is not direct support.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify which groups of animals reproduce by giving birth to live young, such as mammals, and which reproduce by laying eggs, such as birds and reptiles
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about bathing and skin hygiene, with no mention of reproduction, live birth, or egg-laying. It is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Regular bathing keeps a carabao's skin clean and healthy, washing away dirt and old mud.
copy.tl: Ang regular na pagpapaligo sa kalabaw ay nagpapanatiling malinis at malusog ang balat nito, tinatanggal ang dumi at lumang putik.
copy.bis: Ang regular nga pagpaligo sa kabaw magpabiling limpyo ug himsog ang panit niini, mahugasan ang hugaw ug daan nga lapok.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Caramel has a wonderful, toasty smell and a rich taste that plain, white sugar just does not have!

copy.en: Caramel has a wonderful, toasty smell and a rich taste that plain, white sugar just does not have!
copy.tl: Ang caramel ay may bagong mabangong amoy at masarap na lasa na wala sa karaniwang puting asukal!
copy.bis: Ang caramel adunay bag-o ug humot nga baho ug lami nga lasa nga wala sa ordinaryong puti nga asukal!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Carbohydrates from rice, sweet potato, and corn are the body's main source of energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the basic needs of all living things, such as air, food, water, and shelter
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses carbohydrates as an energy source, which is a property of food, but does not directly teach that living things need food, air, water, or shelter as basic needs.

copy.en: Carbohydrates from rice, sweet potato, and corn are the body's main source of energy for playing and studying.
copy.tl: Ang karbohidrato mula sa kanin, kamote, at mais ang pangunahing pinagkukunan ng enerhiya ng katawan para sa paglalaro at pag-aaral.
copy.bis: Ang karbohidrato gikan sa kan-on, kamote, ug mais mao ang panguna nga tinubdan sa kusog sa lawas alang sa pagdula ug pagtuon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Carbohydrates are the body's main source of energy.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: using a labeled diagram, trace how food travels through the digestive tract and explain how different digestive processes work, including mechanical processing, secretion, digestion, absorption, and elimination
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses carbohydrate metabolism (glucose, glycogen) but does not trace food through the digestive tract, describe digestive processes, or use a labeled diagram as required by the competency.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the digestive system as mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not identify or describe any parts of the digestive system (mouth, gullet, stomach, etc.) nor use pictures or labeled diagrams. It only mentions a nutrient, not the digestive system anatomy.

copy.en: Carbohydrates are the body's main source of energy. They break down into glucose for our cells, and any extra is stored as glycogen in the liver and muscles.
copy.tl: Ang carbohydrates ang pangunahing pinagkukunan ng energy ng katawan. Nasisira ito sa glucose na ginagamit ng mga selula, at ang sobra ay naiimbak bilang glycogen sa atay at kalamnan.
copy.bis: Ang carbohydrate mao ang panguna nga tinubdan sa enerhiya sa lawas. Napukan kini sa glucose nga gamiton sa mga selula, ug ang sobra gitipigan isip glycogen sa atay ug kaunuran.

copy.en: A freshly dug diamond looks rough and dull! An expert cuts and polishes it to create many flat faces that catch the light beautifully.
copy.tl: Ang bagong hukay na diamante ay magaspang at mapurol! Hinihiwa at pinakikintab ito ng eksperto para magkaroon ng maraming mukha na sumasalamin sa liwanag.
copy.bis: Ang bag-ong kalot nga diamante magaspang ug pulpol! Gahiwa ug gapasaw kini sa eksperto aron magbaton og daghang nawong nga mosalamin sa kahayag.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: because their atoms line up so evenly
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use diagrams and illustrations to describe the arrangement, spacing, and relative motion of the particles in each of the three states (phases) of matter
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions atomic arrangement as the cause of diamond's crystal shape, but it does not describe the arrangement, spacing, and relative motion of particles in the three states of matter, nor does it use diagrams or illustrations as required by the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Diamonds grow into neat shapes with pointed corners
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a physical property (geometric shape) of a solid, but it does not describe the typical physical properties listed in the competency (hard, shiny, stretchable) nor does it address solid materials generally. The focus is on crystal growth, not on identifying or describing physical properties of solid materials.

copy.en:
What shape do diamonds grow in nature?

Diamonds grow into neat shapes with pointed corners — often like two pyramids joined together — because their atoms line up so evenly!
copy.tl:
Anong hugis ang tumutubo ng diamante sa kalikasan?

Tumutubo ang diamante sa maayos na hugis na may patulis na sulok — parang dalawang piramide na pinagdikit — dahil maayos ang pagkakaayos ng atomo nito!
copy.bis:
Unsay porma sa diamante nga motubo sa kinaiyahan?

Motubo ang diamante sa hapsay nga porma nga adunay tinuhog nga eskina — sama sa duha ka piramide nga gidugtong — tungod sa hapsay nga pagkahan-ay sa atomo niini!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: your hard bones actually contain carbon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions bones (part of the skeletal system) but does not describe how the skeletal system works; it only gives a fact about bone composition.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: This carbon gives your bones strength and a little flexibility
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions hardness, strength, and flexibility of bones, but it does not describe the physical properties of solid materials in general; it focuses on a specific biological material.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: your bones have collagen, a protein full of carbon
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the properties of pure substances as: a. having fixed chemical composition, examples of which are elements and compounds, and b. that all the atoms of an element have a unique number of protons
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions carbon as an element in a protein, but it does not describe properties of pure substances, fixed chemical composition, or unique proton numbers.

copy.en:
Did you know your hard bones actually contain carbon?

Besides calcium, your bones have collagen, a protein full of carbon! This carbon gives your bones strength and a little flexibility so they do not snap easily.
copy.tl:
Alam mo bang ang matitigas mong buto ay mayroon pang carbon?

Bukod sa calcium, ang buto mo ay may collagen, isang protina na puno ng carbon! Nagbibigay ito ng lakas at kaunting lambot sa buto para hindi madaling mabali.
copy.bis:
Nahibaw-an ba nimo nga ang gahi nimong bukog adunay carbon?

Gawas sa calcium, ang bukog adunay collagen, usa ka protina nga puno sa carbon! Naghatag kini og kusog ug gamayng kahumok sa bukog aron dili dali mabali.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: The card only states that carnivorous plants make food through photosynthesis. It does not describe the process of photosynthesis or respiration, nor identify raw materials and products, so it does not directly support G8-L-9.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions plants making food from sunlight, but G3-L-5 is about observing outer plant parts (leaves, roots, stems) and their role in getting water and nutrients from soil. The card does not address plant parts or water/nutrient uptake.

copy.en:
Do meat-eating plants still make food?

Yes — even though they eat insects, these plants still make their own food from sunlight through photosynthesis.
copy.tl:
Gumagawa pa rin ba ng sariling pagkain ang insektibor na halaman?

Oo — kahit kumakain ng insekto, gumagawa pa rin ng sariling pagkain ang mga halamang ito mula sa sikat ng araw sa pamamagitan ng potosintesis.
copy.bis:
Naghimo pa ba og kaugalingong pagkaon ang tanom nga mokaon og insekto?

Oo — bisan mokaon sila og insekto, kining mga tanoma naghimo gihapon sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon gikan sa kahayag sa adlaw pinaagi sa potosintesis.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: Color is a physical property, but the competency focuses on describing physical properties of solid materials such as hard, shiny, or stretchable. The card does not describe solid materials' properties in that sense; it only mentions color as a plant pigment effect.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: These pigments give plants their colors and stay visible in leaves when chlorophyll breaks down in autumn.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: Mentions chlorophyll breakdown, which is tangentially related to photosynthesis, but does not describe the process of photosynthesis or respiration, nor identify raw materials and products. No direct instructional support.

copy.en:
Why do carrots and ripe bananas have bright orange and yellow colors?

It’s because of carotenoids! These pigments give plants their colors and stay visible in leaves when chlorophyll breaks down in autumn.
copy.tl:
Bakit may maliwanag na orange at dilaw na kulay ang karot at mature na saging?

Dahil ito sa mga carotenoid! Ang mga pigment na ito ang nagbibigay ng kulay at nananatili sa dahon kapag nawala ang chlorophyll sa taglamig.
copy.bis:
Nganong adunay hayag nga orange ug dalag nga kolor ang karot ug hinog nga saging?

Tungod kini sa mga carotenoid! Kini nga mga pigment ang naghatag sa kolor ug nagpabilin sa mga dahon kon ang chlorophyll mabungkag sa tagtugnaw.

assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions cells but does not teach microscope techniques or identifying cell parts (membrane, nucleus, cytoplasm, mitochondria, chloroplasts). It is only tangentially about cells.

copy.en: When raw cassava is grated or crushed, it releases the cyanide poison hidden inside its cells.
copy.tl: Kapag kinudkod o dinurog ang hilaw na kamoteng-kahoy, naglalabas ito ng lasong cyanide mula sa mga selula nito.
copy.bis: Kon kudkoron o dugmokon ang hilaw nga balanghoy, mogawas ang cyanide nga hilo gikan sa mga selula niini.

assignedReviews.reason: The card mentions cooking (temperature change) but does not describe changes in properties of materials as required by the competency, which focuses on examples like burning wood or coal. The card is about food safety, not material property changes.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the purpose of specialized structures in plants, such as rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, and aerial roots
assignedReviews.reason: The competency is about specialized structures in plants (rhizomes, tubers, thorns, bulbs, aerial roots). copy.en: Cassava must be cooked all the way through until soft — that's how you know the poison inside is gone.
copy.tl: Dapat lutuing mabuti ang kamoteng kahoy hanggang malambot ito, para masiguradong nawala na ang lason.
copy.bis: Kinahanglan lutoon og maayo ang balanghoy hangtod molumo kini, aron masiguro nga nawala na ang hilo.

copy.tl: Narating at umikot ang Cassini spacecraft sa magandang planetang Saturn noong taong 2004. Nakakatuwang space adventure ito!
copy.bis: Ang Cassini spacecraft nakaabot ug milibot sa nindot nga planeta nga Saturn sa tuig 2004. Katingad-an nga space adventure niini!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A cat can pull in and push out its claws, so they stay sharp and don't wear down when it walks.

copy.en:
Why are a cat's claws always sharp?

A cat can pull in and push out its claws, so they stay sharp and don't wear down when it walks.
copy.tl:
Bakit palaging matalas ang kuko ng pusa?

Kaya itago at ilabas ng pusa ang kanyang mga kuko, kaya nananatili itong matalas at hindi napupudpod kapag naglalakad.
copy.bis:
Nganong kanunay hait ang kuko sa iring?

Mahimong itago ug ipagawas sa iring ang iyang mga kuko, busa magpabilin kining hait ug dili mapudpod kung molakaw.

copy.en: Got a pet cat? It'll likely be part of the family for about 13 to 17 years!
copy.tl: May alagang pusa ka? Malamang mananatili itong kasama mo nang mga 13 hanggang 17 taon!
copy.bis: Aduna kay binuhi nga iring? Lagmit magpabilin kini uban nimo sa mga 13 ngadto sa 17 ka tuig!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A cat meows mostly to talk to people — and gives a soft purr when it's happy and calm.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes cat communication (meowing, purring) but does not teach the general characteristics of living things (grow, respond, reproduce). It does not explicitly connect these behaviors to the concept of responding as a life characteristic, nor does it address growth or reproduction. It is only tangentially related to the 'respond' characteristic.

copy.en:
Why does a cat meow at you?

A cat meows mostly to talk to people — and gives a soft purr when it's happy and calm.
copy.tl:
Bakit umiingiyaw ang pusa sa iyo?

Umiingiyaw ang pusa lalo na para makipag-usap sa tao — at humuhugong nang marahan kapag masaya at kalmado ito.
copy.bis:
Nganong mongiyaw ang iring nimo?

Mongiyaw ang iring ilabina aron makigsulti sa tawo — ug mohinay og purr kon malipayon ug kalmado kini.
